mappingSource: catalog only (vkb.json: control list from VKB's product page https://vkbsimcontrollers.com/products/kg12-gf-gen-1-add-on-grip-for-gunfighter-mk-iii - folding metal trigger, bomb release button, 4-way hat, profile-shift pinky button, lockable twist adapter (MaRS); no numbering found, parts have no inputs). vkbsimcontrollers.com/pages/downloads has no KG12 template.
note: physical identification is mine from the product page list: bomb release = round button on top of the head, 4-way hat = cap in the angled housing on the left of the head (seen at an angle), pinky button = small round button at the lower front of the grip (seen edge-on; gallery-3 shows it from the side at 0.515 0.645). Unlike the Gen.2 (vkb-gunfighter-kg12) there is no pinky lever and no side button. add-on grip only: the gimbal marker sits on the grip connector, the base is not on the photo.
